mapper.select: SELECT a.id, a.title, a.description, a.category, a.location, a.start_time AS startTime, a.end_time AS endTime, a.capacity, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM registrations r WHERE r.activity_id = a.id AND r.status = 'REGISTERED') AS registeredCount FROM activities a ORDER BY a.start_time ASC

SELECT a.id, a.title, a.description, a.category, a.location, a.start_time AS startTime, a.end_time AS endTime, a.capacity, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM registrations r WHERE r.activity_id = a.id AND r.status = 'REGISTERED') AS registeredCount FROM activities a WHERE a.id = #{id}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO activities(title, description, category, location, start_time, end_time, capacity) VALUES(#{title}, #{description}, #{category}, #{location}, #{startTime}, #{endTime}, #{capacity})
